frozen_population_definition.high_water: No explicit source-DB high-water predicate exists in the frozen S2A query; equivalence applies to the same database state at execution time.
frozen_population_definition.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM token_analysis AS ta JOIN pumpfun_migration_verification AS pmv ON ta.mint = pmv.mint WHERE ta.pf_ws_creator IS NOT NULL
frozen_population_definition.semantics: Inner-join eligible token rows to migration-verification rows by mint, then retain rows whose creator is not NULL.
frozen_population_definition.source_boundary: database/flex_complete_database.db read-only; S2A retained discovery_run expects 40301 but this proof does not reproduce or assert that count.

membership_equivalence_proof.cannot_add_members: EXISTS requires the same PMV mint match that the inner join requires; forcing the creator index changes no predicate.
membership_equivalence_proof.cannot_remove_members: Every original joined row has exactly one matching PMV row and passes the identical creator predicate, so it satisfies EXISTS.
membership_equivalence_proof.cardinality: token_analysis.mint is a primary key and pumpfun_migration_verification.mint is a primary key. The observed duplicate PMV mint-group count was 0. Therefore each eligible token row has at most one PMV match, so INNER JOIN cardinality equals EXISTS cardinality.
membership_equivalence_proof.null_and_missing: NULL pf_ws_creator rows are excluded identically. A token row with no PMV mint match is excluded by both INNER JOIN and EXISTS. PK mint equality has identical NULL behavior; no NULL mint can form a match.
membership_equivalence_proof.ordering: COUNT(*) has no ordering semantics. A later authorized manifest must use the separately frozen mint/creator ordering; no ordering or identity output is produced here.
membership_equivalence_proof.predicate_identity: Both queries require exactly ta.pf_ws_creator IS NOT NULL and equality on ta.mint = pmv.mint.

schema_indexed_equivalent.access_path_only: INDEXED BY idx_ta_pf_ws_creator constrains SQLite planning only; it adds no row predicate.
schema_indexed_equivalent.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM token_analysis AS ta INDEXED BY idx_ta_pf_ws_creator WHERE ta.pf_ws_creator IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pumpfun_migration_verification AS pmv WHERE pmv.mint = ta.mint)

scope: semantic proof only; no population query, count, manifest, or candidate identity was materialized
